scope: ordinary swarm overlap adjudication and runner forensics; not an out-of-box experiment

role_separation.merged_pr_396: bounded workflow-continuity defense using exact-SHA run-unique RUNNER_TEMP checkout; target-supported and merged
role_separation.pr_403: persistent-workspace quarantine/cleanup candidate preserving forensic bytes without sudo/delete
role_separation.remaining_root_cause: identify producer of root-owned Python bytecode and prove ordinary shared-workspace checkout remains clean after repair

pr403_target_result.prechecks: runner identity and bounded foreign-path census reached expected contamination
pr403_target_result.failing_operation: mv suspect tree from GITHUB_WORKSPACE to $HOME/.frank-runner-quarantine/...

repair_hypothesis_routed_to_pr403.statement: The destination under $HOME may be on a different filesystem from the Actions work tree. If so, mv degrades to copy+remove, and removal of entries within a root-owned 0755 directory is unavailable to frankrunner. Independently, current preflight checks source-parent ownership but not effective write/execute permissions.
required_falsifier: record st_dev, ownership and modes for suspect, source parent, workspace parent, HOME and destination parent
choose a quarantine parent outside GITHUB_WORKSPACE but on the same st_dev as source
retain no-sudo, no-delete and unexpected-foreign-path fail-closed invariants
after successful rename, rerun a previously checkout-blocked ordinary regression to prove checkout recovery causally

producer_provenance.github_run_correlation: GitHub reported zero workflow runs created during 08:00-08:10 UTC. Two runs were created in 07:30-08:10, including a skipped bounded-dispatch run; no direct producer identity follows from this.
producer_provenance.adjudication: Do not attribute root ownership to an Actions workflow from timestamp coincidence. Manual/root service/container/older long-running job remain unresolved alternatives until direct provenance exists.

architecture_delta.continuity: retain merged isolated-checkout defense for bounded gates
architecture_delta.cleanup: continue existing PR #403 lane after same-filesystem/writability repair or another measured minimal fix
architecture_delta.root_cause: keep producer provenance open and require ordinary checkout revalidation after cleanup
